theory.title: Tercer condicional para situaciones pasadas irreales
theory.explanation: Usa if + past perfect y would have + participio para imaginar un resultado pasado diferente: If we had left earlier, we would have avoided the traffic (si hubiéramos salido antes, habríamos evitado el tráfico). Describe situaciones que no ocurrieron.
theory.tip: If + had + participio, would have + participio: una situación pasada imaginaria.

patterns.label: Tercer condicional para situaciones pasadas irreales · 1
patterns.pattern: If we had left earlier, we would have avoided the traffic.
examples:
If we had left earlier, we would have avoided the traffic.
→ Si hubiéramos salido antes, habríamos evitado el tráfico.

patterns.label: Tercer condicional para situaciones pasadas irreales · 2
patterns.pattern: If I had known about the campaign, I would have joined.
examples:
If I had known about the campaign, I would have joined.
→ Si hubiera sabido lo de la campaña, me habría unido.

patterns.label: Tercer condicional para situaciones pasadas irreales · 3
patterns.pattern: They would have saved energy if they had switched off the lights.
examples:
They would have saved energy if they had switched off the lights.
→ Habrían ahorrado energía si hubieran apagado las luces.

patterns.label: Tercer condicional para situaciones pasadas irreales · 4
patterns.pattern: If the council had listened, the project would have improved.
examples:
If the council had listened, the project would have improved.
→ Si el ayuntamiento hubiera escuchado, el proyecto habría mejorado.

patterns.label: Tercer condicional para situaciones pasadas irreales · 5
patterns.pattern: We wouldn't have missed the bus if we had checked the time.
examples:
We wouldn't have missed the bus if we had checked the time.
→ No habríamos perdido el autobús si hubiéramos comprobado la hora.

patterns.label: Tercer condicional para situaciones pasadas irreales · 6
patterns.pattern: If it hadn't rained, the event would have taken place outside.
examples:
If it hadn't rained, the event would have taken place outside.
→ Si no hubiera llovido, el evento se habría celebrado al aire libre.

patterns.label: Tercer condicional para situaciones pasadas irreales · 7
patterns.pattern: She would have recycled more if the bins had been available.
examples:
She would have recycled more if the bins had been available.
→ Ella habría reciclado más si hubiera habido contenedores disponibles.

patterns.label: Tercer condicional para situaciones pasadas irreales · 8
patterns.pattern: If people had used fewer cars, the air would have been cleaner.
examples:
If people had used fewer cars, the air would have been cleaner.
→ Si la gente hubiera utilizado menos coches, el aire habría estado más limpio.

patterns.label: Tercer condicional para situaciones pasadas irreales · 9
patterns.pattern: The river wouldn't have flooded if the barriers had been stronger.
examples:
The river wouldn't have flooded if the barriers had been stronger.
→ El río no se habría desbordado si las barreras hubieran sido más resistentes.

patterns.label: Tercer condicional para situaciones pasadas irreales · 10
patterns.pattern: If I had brought a reusable bottle, I wouldn't have bought plastic ones.
examples:
If I had brought a reusable bottle, I wouldn't have bought plastic ones.
→ Si hubiera traído una botella reutilizable, no habría comprado botellas de plástico.

content.passage: Last year, the neighbourhood organised a clean-up day, but the event was poorly attended. If the organisers had advertised it earlier, more people would have joined. Some residents said they would have helped if they had known where to meet. The council could have provided more equipment, too. If more volunteers had arrived, the group would have cleaned the whole riverbank. Although the day was not a complete success, the organisers learned useful lessons.

items.prompt: Describe a past situation you would change using the third conditional.
items.modelAnswer: I think communities can make a real difference when people work together. In my area, there are several ways to improve the environment, such as using public transport, reducing waste and supporting local projects. Although change can take time, small actions often lead to better results. If more people took part, the community would become cleaner and healthier. I hope that by the next few years we will have made further progress.

A: The organisers have received a lot of support and hope to continue the project in the future.
